study.title: Accurate Wheat Lodging Extraction from Multi-Channel UAV Images Using a Lightweight Network Model
study.short_title: Mobile U-Net for UAV Wheat Lodging Extraction

dataset.name: UAV wheat-field imagery, National Modern Agriculture Demonstration Zone, Guohe Town, Lujiang County, Anhui, China
dataset.note: 298 UAV images at 30 m height (4000x3000 px) over flowering/filling/maturity stages; RGB, RGB+DSM, RGB+ExG inputs; cropped into 256x256 tiles; classes: lodging wheat, healthy wheat, background.

mIoU.quote: the F1-Score reached 88.99% and the mIoU reached 80.7%, indicating that the fusion image was more suitable for wheat lodging extraction
mIoU.ambiguity: mIoU 80.7% for Mobile U-Net on RGB+DSM test set (150 images).

F1.quote: the F1-Score reached 88.99% and the mIoU reached 80.7%, indicating that the fusion image was more suitable for wheat lodging extraction
F1.ambiguity: F1-score of lodging-wheat segmentation, Mobile U-Net on RGB+DSM test set.

PA.ambiguity: Overall accuracy not separately reported; F1/mIoU used as main metrics.

fps.ambiguity: Only relative processing-speed improvements vs FCN/U-Net; no FPS/latency figures.

params_M.quote: FCN was 17.08 million, U-Net was 30.95 million and Mobile U-Net was only 9.49 million
params_M.ambiguity: Model structural parameter count (Mobile U-Net), not an embedded/edge deployment metric; model tested on Intel i7-1065G7 CPU.
